entities.summary: Sussan Deyhim (b. 1958-12-14, Tehran) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tehran and Iran. Known in the fields of iran, composers & musicians, asia.
